name: White Organic Retail Limited
summary: White Organic Retail Limited (WORL.BO) specializes in the commercial exchange of agricultural produce and the distribution of organic products. Its offerings encompass a diverse range of items, including cereals, pulses, fresh fruits, and vegetables. The company conducts its business operations across three distinct divisions: wholesale and distribution, traditional retail, and an e-commerce platform. Established on December 19, 2011, this Mumbai, India-headquartered firm serves its customers through these varied channels.
